goal: Put each named category of objects into the specified basket (left, middle, right) as given in the language instruction, then put the arm back home.
instruction_templates: Put {cat0} objects into the left basket, {cat1} objects into the middle basket, and {cat2} objects into the right basket, then reset the robot arm.
success: A label is 'in' a basket when the object's root origin xy lies inside the basket's bbox footprint (convex hull of the oriented 3D bbox projected to xy) and its root z is strictly above the bbox's lowest z. All objects of category cat0 (the category named first in the instruction) are inside basket0 (the 'left' basket, x=-0.28); all objects of cat1 (named second) are inside basket1 (middle, x=0.0); all objects of cat2 (named third) are inside basket2 (right, x=+0.28).
Settled: for each i in 0..2, every object of cat_i has root z - (top z of the world-frame bbox of basket_i) < 0.01 m (objects not held high above the rim).
All target robots back at start end-effector pose: |dx|,|dy|,|dz| each <= 0.15 m and rotation <= 20 degrees (all_robot_back_to_origin defaults).
evaluation: Checked after every action (the reward manager step runs after each action's control sequence completes). One stage: all conditions simultaneously; first such step is success. Otherwise failure at step_lim=1100 actions. Process score (partial only): stages need grippers open (>= 0.8) and 1 / 2 / 3 categories correctly placed (scores 10, 40, 100), also requiring other categories not in that basket.
objects: basket0: basket (category basket, index 2), fixed, x=-0.28, y=0.05, no rotation (leftmost, lowest x)
basket1: basket (category basket, index 3), fixed, x=0.0, y=0.05 (middle)
basket2: basket (category basket, index 4), fixed, x=+0.28, y=0.05 (rightmost, highest x)

cat0, cat1, cat2: 3 distinct categories drawn at random from {watch (index 4-7), car (index 10-15), wooden_toy (index 0-4), pepper (index 0-2), chocolate_bar (index 0-4)}; each category has 2 to 3 instances (select_instance_nums [2,3], inclusive range, duplicates allowed). Scattered on the table x in [-0.43,0.43], y in [-0.23,0.0], yaw within +/-60 deg, margin 0.01 m.
needs_memory_or_language: Yes. The agent must read the instruction: it names three categories (the category names come from the objects' model_name, e.g. 'watch', 'car', 'wooden_toy', 'pepper', 'chocolate_bar'), in order left, middle, right basket. The instruction template is filled at runtime with cat0, cat1, cat2 category names, so the mapping must come from the text.
end_requirements: All target arms back within 0.15 m per axis and 20 degrees of start pose at the moment of success.
notes: Instruction categories map to baskets in order: first named -> basket0 (left, lowest x), second -> middle, third -> right (highest x). 'left' here is defined by basket label/x order; if the camera view is mirrored the instruction's 'left' still corresponds to basket0 at x=-0.28. gen_instruction returns an empty string if any category has no object. Exact category name strings come from asset metadata (model_name), not determinable statically.
